findings.description: List endpoint does not have limit/offset or similar pagination parameters, which could lead to data exposure and performance issues.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add pagination parameters (limit, offset, page, page_size) to all list endpoints.
findings.title: List endpoint missing pagination parameters

findings.description: The OpenAPI specification does not define rate limiting using x-ratelimit extensions.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add x-ratelimit extensions to document rate limiting policies.
findings.title: Missing x-ratelimit extension in spec

findings.description: Endpoint does not define any 4xx (client error) responses.
findings.fix_suggestion: Define appropriate 4xx responses (400, 401, 403, 404) for all endpoints.
findings.title: Endpoint missing 4xx error responses

findings.description: Endpoint does not define any 5xx (server error) responses.
findings.fix_suggestion: Define 500 response for all endpoints to document server error handling.
findings.title: Endpoint missing 5xx error responses
